title: Semivan on a non-state intelligence network and the 2016 leaks

tellings.quote: According to Semivan, a non-state intelligence network is responsible for the leaking of these emails

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a narrator relays a claim from Jim Semivan, a former CIA officer. According to Semivan, a private intelligence network not belonging to any government was behind the emails leaked in 2016, during the US election between Hillary Clinton and Donald Trump, with Mike Pompeo also named in the telling. If true, it would mean a hidden group outside government helped shape that election.
